description: This file is the main activity for an Android Wear app that checks if a specific phone app is installed on the paired device. It uses GoogleApiClient and the Wearable APIs to monitor capability changes indicating app installation status, and provides a button to open the app's page on the appropriate app store if missing.

classes.name: MainWearActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Wearable app that manages capability checks and interactions with the paired phone device.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects GoogleApiClient appropriately when activity is paused.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient connects; sets up capability listener and initiates app presence check.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Handles updates in capability info indicating app installation or removal.

methods.name: checkIfPhoneHasApp
methods.description: Queries the capability API to determine if the phone app is installed on the paired device.

methods.name: verifyNodeAndUpdateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI based on whether the target node (phone with app) is available.

methods.name: openAppInStoreOnPhone
methods.description: Attempts to open the app's store page on the remote device via RemoteIntent, based on availability.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate node from a set, typically the first available, to communicate with.
